AI.motivation: CeRh2As2是重费米子超导体，展现低场与高场两个超导相，通常被解释为序参量宇称随磁场改变；但其超导与磁性序邻近，磁序微观起源不明，且Ce 4f的晶体电场分裂双重态形成特殊"准四重态"，有人提出四极自由度很重要。目前缺乏统一描述这些现象的微观理论。
AI.method: 建立含准四重态结构与非点式对称性的微观重费米子模型：在多轨道周期Anderson模型中纳入最低的Γ7、Γ6双重态，允许与传导d电子的非局域杂化；用旋转不变Slave-boson方法强制4f态单占据；采用平均场处理，先推导有效低能哈密顿量，再允许磁性基态求解。
AI.result: 有效低能哈密顿量可由单轨道紧束缚模型准确描述，支持文献中的最小模型；模型在广泛参数区域呈现金属性Q=(π,π)反铁磁序；铁磁解也存在但参数区间更小、对载流子浓度和f-d杂化形式更敏感；四极矩仅在磁有序相内出现且通常很小，只有当Γ7与Γ6双重态近乎简并时才显著。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解CeRh2As2的巡游重费米子物理及有序相提供了微观基础，表明反铁磁序是主要磁基态，四极自由度仅在特定简并条件下起作用。

title: Emergent frustrated magnetism in strain-patterned graphene
summary: Geometrically frustrated magnetism conventionally arises from pre-existing magnetic moments on lattices whose geometry prevents their interactions from being simultaneously satisfied, giving rise to highly degenerate states and rich collective behavior. Creating such frustration in an intrinsically non-magnetic material presents a fundamentally different challenge, requiring both the magnetism and the competing interactions to emerge from correlated electrons. Here we show that this can be realized in graphene through lithographically programmable strain engineering. Patterning strain and the associated pseudo-magnetic field (PMF) into superlattices creates a correlated electronic system with flat bands and strong interactions. Transport measurements reveal interaction-driven insulating behavior, anisotropic magnetic hysteresis, and slow relaxation dynamics reminiscent of spin freezing, qualitatively captured by Monte Carlo simulations of competing magnetic moments on the PMF-defined ruby superlattice. Cryogenic magnetic force microscopy further reveals magnetic textures associated with the PMF landscape. These observations demonstrate frustrated magnetism emerging from correlated electrons in otherwise non-magnetic graphene. Our results establish lithographic strain engineering as a general and scalable route to flat bands and correlated states in van der Waals materials, providing a versatile platform for programmable quantum matter.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过在石墨烯中利用光刻应变工程构造赝磁场超晶格，实现平坦带与强相互作用，从而在原本非磁性的石墨烯中观测到由关联电子涌现的阻挫磁性。
AI.motivation: 传统几何阻挫磁性依赖材料中预先存在的磁矩与特定晶格几何，而要在本征非磁性材料中产生阻挫磁性需让磁性与竞争相互作用都从关联电子中涌现，这与传统思路根本不同，是一个新挑战。
AI.method: 采用光刻可编程应变工程，在石墨烯中图案化应变及其伴随的赝磁场（PMF），形成超晶格，构建具有平坦带与强相互作用的关联电子体系；结合输运测量、蒙特卡洛模拟以及低温磁力显微镜进行表征。
AI.result: 输运测量显示相互作用驱动的绝缘行为、各向异性磁滞以及类似自旋冻结的慢弛豫动力学，蒙特卡洛模拟在PMF定义的ruby超晶格上对竞争磁矩的模拟定性吻合；低温磁力显微镜进一步揭示了与PMF势场相关的磁纹理。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明在非磁性石墨烯中可涌现阻挫磁性，确立了光刻应变工程作为在范德华材料中实现平坦带与关联态的通用可扩展途径，为可编程量子物质提供了通用平台。

title: Strain-controlled topology and quantum control at a cubic Ce$^{3+}$ crystal-field crossing
summary: Field-tuned crystal-field crossings provide a route to synthetic topology in localized rare-earth degrees of freedom when symmetry-resolved perturbations can independently control the crossing states. Here we show that a field-induced crossing in cubic Ce$^{3+}$ has precisely this structure. For $B\parallel[001]$, the crossing is protected by a twofold rotation, while the $T_{2g}$ shears $ε_{xz}$ and $ε_{yz}$ break that protection and mix the two states through orthogonal pseudospin components. Together with magnetic-field detuning, these controls generate an isolated diabolical point with unit-magnitude Chern charge in a three-dimensional parameter space. Using the CeTe crystal-field scale gives an ideal single-ion crossing near $35.5$ T. A calibrated point-charge calculation gives a representative projected shear coupling $|α_{T_{2g}}|\simeq18.1$ meV per unit tensor strain, corresponding to gaps of $0.036$ and $0.072$ meV for tensor shears of $0.10\%$ and $0.20\%$. We identify the associated elastic and magnetic signatures, discuss the limitations of the electrostatic estimate in a hybridizing Ce compound, and determine the adiabatic and coherence requirements for cyclic geometric control. The result is a symmetry-based framework that connects high-field crystal-field reconstruction, strain response, and parameter-space topology in rare-earth systems.

AI.tldr: 该文展示了立方Ce³⁺在[001]磁场下由晶场交叉点形成受保护简并，T₂g剪切应变打破保护并在三维参数空间产生单位Chern荷的孤立法向点，为稀土系统提供了连接高场晶场重构、应变响应与参数空间拓扑的对称性框架。
AI.motivation: 利用磁场调控局域稀土自由度的晶场交叉点，是构建合成拓扑的潜在途径，但前提是能通过对称性分辨的扰动独立控制交叉的两个态。作者意在寻找一个能实现这种独立性控制的物理体系。
AI.method: 以立方Ce³⁺为对象，在B∥[001]下分析二重旋转保护的交叉点；引入T₂g剪切应变εxz、εyz（通过正交赝自旋分量混合两态）并结合磁场失谐，构造三维参数空间；用CeTe晶场尺度估算交叉磁场，并用标定点电荷模型计算投影剪切耦合强度与能隙。
AI.result: B∥[001]交叉点受二重旋转保护，剪切应变破缺该保护并混合两态，与磁场失谐共同在三维参数空间产生孤立diabolical point，携带单位大小Chern荷。CeTe晶场尺度给出约35.5 T的理想单离子交叉。标定点电荷计算得到投影剪切耦合|α_T2g|≈18.1 meV每单位张量应变，对应0.10%和0.20%张量剪切的能隙分别为0.036和0.072 meV。作者还识别了相应弹性与磁学特征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了一个基于对称性的框架，将高场晶场重构、应变响应与参数空间拓扑联系起来，适用于稀土系统；同时讨论了在杂化Ce化合物中静电估算的局限，并确定了循环几何控制的绝热与相干性要求。

title: The renormalization group for a slab model of the spin reorientation transition
comment: 23 pages (main text 7 pages, 1 figure; Supplemental Material included, 16 pages, 1 figure). Submitted to Papers in Physics
summary: In 1975, Polyakov invented a renormalization group algorithm for treating the problem of a classical isotropic planar Heisenberg ferromagnet. Here we define a tool - "parallel transport of frames" - that extends Polyakov's original renormalization group method to local magnetic anisotropies and, most significantly, the non-local dipolar interaction. We apply this tool to the problem of the spin reorientation transition in an ultrathin ferromagnetic slab with finite thickness. We find that integrating out the short wavelength spin wave fluctuations generates two local anisotropies that are absent from the microscopic dipolar energy Hamiltonian. Taking them into account yields the correct topology of the spin reorientation transition line, as observed experimentally and in numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出"标架平行移动"工具，将Polyakov重整化群方法推广到含局部各向异性和非局域偶极相互作用的体系，用于研究超薄铁磁薄膜的自旋重取向相变。
AI.motivation: Polyakov 1975年提出的重整化群算法仅适用于经典各向同性平面Heisenberg铁磁体，无法处理局部磁各向异性和非局域的偶极相互作用，而这些在超薄铁磁薄膜的自旋重取向相变中至关重要。
AI.method: 定义"标架平行移动"工具，扩展Polyakov重整化群方法以纳入局部各向异性和非局域偶极相互作用；将其应用于有限厚度超薄铁磁板，通过积分掉短波长自旋波涨落。
AI.result: 积分掉短波长自旋波涨落后产生了两个微观偶极能哈密顿量中不存在的局域各向异性项。
AI.conclusion: 计入这两个新生成的局域各向异性后，可获得与实验和数值模拟一致的自旋重取向相变线拓扑结构。

title: Criticality enabled long-range order in a U(1)-symmetric spin-1 Heisenberg chain with biquadratic interactions
summary: In a recent paper Nahum argued on the basis of a renormalization-group analysis that, contrary to standard lore, ground states of 1D spin chains with short-range interactions can spontaneously break U(1) ``easy-plane'' spin rotation symmetry. True long-range order of $(S^x,S^y)$ arises at the phase transition between two quasi-long-range-ordered phases. Here we present detailed numerical results for an anisotropic spin-1 chain model. We find a magnetization exponent $β\approx0.29$, consistent with the $ε$-expansion prediction $β\approx0.28$, a divergence of the Luttinger parameter on approaching the transition from both sides with an exponent that we relate to Nahum's transition, and finite-size spectra consistent with a dynamical critical exponent $z\approx2$. Our results support the critical behavior predicted by Nahum's field theory.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值方法研究各向异性自旋-1链模型，验证了Nahum提出的1D短程相互作用自旋链基态可自发破缺U(1)易面自旋旋转对称性的理论预测。
AI.motivation: Nahum基于重整化群分析提出，与标准认知相反，1D短程相互作用自旋链的基态可自发破缺U(1)易面自旋旋转对称性，在两个准长程有序相之间的相变处会出现(S^x,S^y)的真正长程有序。作者希望用数值证据检验这一理论。
AI.method: 对各向异性自旋-1链模型进行详细的数值计算（如DMRG/有限尺寸谱分析），提取磁化指数、Luttinger参数发散行为及动力学临界指数。
AI.result: 测得磁化指数β≈0.29，与ε展开预测β≈0.28一致；Luttinger参数在相变两侧均以与Nahum相变相关的指数发散；有限尺寸谱与动力学临界指数z≈2相符。
AI.conclusion: 数值结果支持Nahum场论所预测的临界行为，即为1D自旋链中U(1)对称性自发破缺提供了证据。

title: HOMO-LUMO Intervals from Modern Density Functionals as Fundamental Gap Estimators
summary: Use of the Kohn-Sham eigenvalue gap (highest occupied molecular orbital to lowest unoccupied, HOMO-LUMO) as a fundamental gap (I-A, I= ionization potential, A= electron affinity) estimator is a long-standing challenge for relatively simple exchange-correlation functionals, e.g. meta-GGAs. The LAK meta-GGA [T. Lebeda et al. Phys. Rev. Lett. 133, 136402 (2024)] was developed to emphasize certain constraints in ways intended to make the LAK KS gaps close to the HSE06 hybrid functional [A.V. Krudau et al. J.Chem. Phys. 125, 224106 (2006)] gaps. The LAK functional was tested against a small atomization data set and a very small bond length set, with no molecular HOMO-LUMO gap testing. Here we test LAK against widely used, large reference data sets for molecular heats of formation, bond lengths, harmonic frequencies, I, and A and compare with r2SCAN [J.W. Furness et al., J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 11, 8208 (2020)] as well as HSE06 and PBE0, a quite different hybrid. On these tests LAK does not give meaningfully better geometries, heats of formation, HOMO-LUMO gaps, or DFT IP theorem satisfaction than r2SCAN. Compared against experimental I and A values the same holds; LAK results resemble r2SCAN results, not HSE06. Moreover, the HOMO and LUMO shifts generated by the NCAPR GGA [J. Carmona-Espindola et al., J. Chem. Phys. 157, 114109 (2022)] as derivative discontinuity estimates, correct the bare NCAPR HOMO and LUMO eigenvalues to substantially better agreement with experiment for both fundamental gap and IP theorem than do the meta-GGAs (LAK, r2SCAN) or hybrids (HSE, PBE0). We discuss possible reasons why LAK behaves differently for molecules and solids.

AI.tldr: 本文测试LAK meta-GGA泛函在大规模分子数据集上的表现，发现其几何、生成热、HOMO-LUMO gap及IP定理满足度均未优于r2SCAN，行为更接近r2SCAN而非HSE06。
AI.motivation: Kohn-Sham HOMO-LUMO gap作为基本gap(I-A)的估计长期是难题；LAK meta-GGA被开发使KS gap接近HSE06，但仅在小数据集测试且未测分子HOMO-LUMO gap，需大规模验证。
AI.method: 在大型参考数据集上测试LAK的生成热、键长、谐频、I和A，并与r2SCAN、HSE06、PBE0对比；同时用NCAPR GGA的HOMO/LUMO位移作为导数不连续性估计进行测试。
AI.result: LAK未带来明显更好的几何、生成热、HOMO-LUMO gap或IP定理满足度，结果类似r2SCAN而非HSE06；NCAPR位移修正后与实验的gap和IP定理一致性优于meta-GGA和hybrid。
AI.conclusion: LAK在分子上表现与r2SCAN相似，未达到接近HSE06的目标；讨论了LAK在分子与固体中行为差异的可能原因。

title: A hydrogen-informed Rice-Beltz model for crack-tip dislocation emission under mixed-mode loading
summary: The fundamental competition between crack-tip cleavage and dislocation emission dictates the ductile-to-brittle transition in crystalline solids. In hydrogen-charged environments, this delicate balance is disrupted, yet existing models often struggle to self-consistently capture the atomic-scale thermomechanical modulation of the emission barrier. Here, we propose the hydrogen-informed Rice-Beltz framework to quantify the critical stress intensity factors (SIFs) required for initial dislocation nucleation under mixed-mode (I+II) loading. By integrating the elastic interaction of the dilatational field of interstitial hydrogen and the applied stress fields against the incipient dislocation core, the model recovers the non-monotonic relation between the most probable SIF and the hydrogen concentration. Unlike the classical pure mode-I (or mode-II) scenario, the minimization of the local strain energy density is employed to generate closed-form nominal driving forces, which are subsequently embedded into a transition-state-theory framework. This atomistically-informed approach yields the most probable SIF for the first dislocation emission event as a function of the loading rate, slip angle, and hydrogen concentration, providing a rigorous, parameter-free boundary condition for the onset of hydrogen-modulated crack-tip plasticity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"氢信息Rice-Beltz框架"，定量计算混合模式(I+II)加载下氢致位错形核的临界应力强度因子，实现原子尺度热力学-力学调控的自洽建模。
AI.motivation: 晶体固体中裂纹尖端解理与位错发射的竞争决定韧脆转变，而氢环境中这一平衡被打破；现有模型难以自洽地捕捉氢对发射势垒的原子尺度热力-力学调控。
AI.method: 将间隙氢膨胀场的弹性相互作用与外加应力场对初生位错核心的作用相耦合，采用局部应变能密度最小化（而非经典纯I/II模式）推导闭式名义驱动力，并嵌入过渡态理论框架。
AI.result: 模型复现了最可能应力强度因子随氢浓度的非单调关系，并给出首次位错发射事件的最可能SIF随加载速率、滑移角和氢浓度的函数关系。
AI.conclusion: 该原子信息方法为氢调控裂纹尖端塑性的起始提供了严格、无参数（parameter-free）的边界条件。

title: 2D target search with boundary-induced resetting
summary: Most studies of stochastic search processes with resetting focus on spontaneous resetting events that occur at a random sequence of times typically generated by a Poisson process. One of the major consequences of spontaneous resetting is that it yields a finite mean first passage time (MFPT) in unbounded domains, resulting in an optimal resetting rate that minimises the MFPT. An optimal resetting rate can also occur in bounded domains provided that the reset point is not too far from the target. Recently, there has been growing interest in event-based rather than spontaneous resetting, where resetting is triggered when a specific threshold is reached. Identifying the threshold with a physical non-target boundary then leads to so-called boundary-induced resetting. In this paper, we explore the effects of boundary-induced resetting on single-particle diffusive search in a two-dimensional (2D) bounded domain $Ω$ containing one or more small interior targets. The interior target boundaries are totally absorbing, whereas the exterior boundary $\partial Ω$ is sticky. That is, whenever the particle reaches a point on $\partial Ω$ it remains attached for a random waiting time $τ$ after which it immediately resets to a fixed interior point $\x_0\in Ω$. Using renewal theory, matched asymptotic analysis and Green's functions we calculate the unconditional MFPT for absorption by any of the targets and compare this with the corresponding MFPT of a search process on the same domain with a reflecting surface $\partial Ω$ and no resetting. We show that boundary-induced resetting only reduces the MFPT relative to the no resetting case if the searcher's reset point $\x_0$ is sufficiently close to one of the targets.

AI.tldr: 研究二维有界域中边界诱导重置对单粒子扩散搜索MFPT的影响。
AI.motivation: 已有随机搜索重置研究多聚焦泊松自发重置，而事件/边界触发重置（尤其有界域中粘性外边界重置）研究较少。
AI.method: 结合更新理论、匹配渐近分析和格林函数，计算小内靶吸收的无条件MFPT。
AI.result: 只有重置点x0足够接近某个靶时，边界诱导重置才能相对无重置反射边界情形降低MFPT。
AI.conclusion: 边界诱导重置并非总有益，其有效性取决于重置点与目标的接近程度。

title: A Unified Spin-Fermion Framework for Magnetic Diversity in Chromium Monopnictides
summary: Isoelectronic compounds are generally expected to exhibit related electronic, structural, and magnetic behavior. Chromium monopnictides CrX (X= Sb, As, P), however, display a striking evolution from high-temperature altermagnetism in NiAs-type CrSb, through double-helical antiferromagnetism in MnP-type CrAs, to the absence of resolved long-range magnetic order in MnP-type CrP. Here, combining first-principles calculations in the non-collinear Curie-paramagnetic state, structural analysis, magnetic phase-diagram calculations, and exchange-parameter extraction, we establish a unified microscopic framework for this evolution. All three compounds share a formal high-spin $d^5$ configuration, nominally Cr$^{1+}$, coupled to itinerant states of predominantly pnictogen character. From Sb to P, chemical pressure enhances ligand itinerancy and drives the structural evolution from the high-symmetry NiAs lattice to increasingly distorted MnP-type networks. The accompanying reconstruction of competing Cr-Cr exchanges favors A-type antiferromagnetism in CrSb and double-helical order in CrAs, while placing CrP near a frustrated regime with closely competing magnetic tendencies. Our results establish chemical-pressure-driven exchange reconstruction as a general mechanism through which a common spin-fermion electronic structure can generate contrasting magnetic phases in strongly correlated materials.

AI.tldr: CrX(X=Sb,As,P)等电子化合物磁性差异巨大，本文用第一性原理等建立统一微观框架，揭示化学压力驱动的交换重构机制。
AI.motivation: 等电子化合物通常预期有相似性质，但CrX(Sb→P)从高温交替磁性到双螺旋反铁磁再到无明显长程磁序，差异显著，需统一解释。
AI.method: 结合非共线居里顺磁态第一性原理计算、结构分析、磁相图计算及交换参数提取。
AI.result: 三者共享形式高自旋d^5(Cr1+)构型，耦合到以磷族为主的巡游态；从Sb到P化学压力增强配体巡游性，驱动结构从NiAs到MnP畸变；交换重构使CrSb倾向A型反铁磁、CrAs双螺旋序、CrP近阻挫区。
AI.conclusion: 化学压力驱动的交换重构是共同自旋-费米电子结构产生不同磁相的普适机制，适用于强关联材料。

title: Ferroelectric Switching in ZnO/Zn1-xMgxO Heterostructures: Atomistic Insights into Interfacial Coupling and Layer Architecture
summary: Ferroelectric switching in heterostructures couples composition, layer topology, temperature, and interfacial boundary conditions. ReaxFF molecular dynamics isolates these variables in ZnO/ Zn1- xMgxO/ZnO and Zn1-xMgxO/ZnO/ Zn1-xMgxO stacks. Within pristine, initially single-domain models, coupling to switchable Zn1-xMgxO reduces the applied field required to reverse ZnO by up to fivefold. Temperature generally lowers the coercive field, whereas Mg concentration produces a nonmonotonic response. At equal ZnO and Zn1-xMgxO (ZMO) proportions, structures with ZnO at the center switch at lower fields than those with ZMO at the center at all four temperatures examined, demonstrating a topology-dependent response. Layer-resolved trajectories reveal topology-dependent switching sequences with direction-dependent redistribution of normal stress near the heterointerfaces, consistent with a stress-assisted cooperative pathway. Limiting MgO-containing structures exhibit sequential multilevel switching or low-polarity trapping, depending on thickness and temperature. Fixed-charge atomistic simulations complement previous continuum descriptions by resolving structural, energetic, and local stress evolution under a common applied field. TEM and STEM-EDS observations provide experimental structural context for the modeled architectures. Together, the results establish layer topology and interfacial mechanical confinement as design variables for wurtzite ferroelectric heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 用ReaxFF MD研究ZnO/ZnMgO异质结中极化翻转，揭示层拓扑与界面机械约束是关键设计变量。
AI.motivation: 铁电翻转在异质结中受成分、层拓扑、温度和界面边界条件耦合影响，需隔离这些变量以厘清各自作用。
AI.method: 对ZnO/ZMO/ZnO与ZMO/ZnO/ZMO堆叠进行ReaxFF分子动力学，结合固定电荷原子模拟，并用TEM和STEM-EDS提供结构参照。
AI.result: 耦合可翻转ZMO使ZnO翻转场降低达5倍；温度降低矫顽场，Mg浓度呈非单调响应；ZMO在中心的结构翻转场高于ZnO在中心；层分辨轨迹显示拓扑依赖的翻转顺序与方向依赖的界面法向应力再分布；含MgO极限结构出现多级翻转或低极性俘获。
AI.conclusion: 层拓扑与界面机械约束是纤锌矿铁电异质结的重要设计变量。

title: The conductance filtration: sink-relative persistence and exact edge sensitivity for heat transport in particle-filled composites
summary: We formulate the thermal conductance $g_e$ of a particle pair as three branch types -- contact, near-contact and bond -- within a single construction, and we introduce the filtration that takes this $g_e$ as its axis (the conductance filtration) together with persistence taken relative to the sink boundary. We then show that the dissipation share is exactly the logarithmic sensitivity of the effective conductance, and that a finite change of a single edge is predicted exactly in closed form. The allocation of the dissipation among branch types, and the idealisation ratio of each mechanism (interface, matrix and particle), are thereby obtained as diagnostic quantities on one and the same graph representation.

AI.tldr: 将颗粒对的界面热导 g_e 统一建模为接触、近接触、键合三类分支，并构造以 g_e 为过滤轴的持续性分析，证明耗散份额等于有效电导的对数灵敏度，且单边有限变化可闭式精确预测，进而得到耗散在分支类型中的分配及界面/基体/颗粒三类机制的理想化比率。
AI.motivation: 颗粒复合材料中热传导涉及接触、近接触和键合等多种界面机制，缺乏统一框架来刻画并区分这些机制的贡献，因此需要一个能同时描述多种分支类型并诊断各机制相对重要性的图表示与灵敏度工具。
AI.method: 以颗粒对热导 g_e 为单一构造，定义三类分支（接触、近接触、键合）；构造以 g_e 为轴的过滤（conductance filtration）并进行相对于汇边界的持续性分析；推导耗散份额与有效电导对数灵敏度之间的等价关系，并给出单条边有限变化的闭式预测公式。
AI.result: 证明耗散份额恰为有效电导的对数灵敏度；单边有限变化可精确闭式预测；由此在同一图表示上获得耗散在各分支类型间的分配，以及界面、基体、颗粒三类机制各自的理想化比率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将多种界面传热机制纳入统一的图论与持续同调框架，把耗散分配与理想化比率确立为可直接诊断的量化指标，为颗粒体系热传导的多机制分析提供了通用工具。

title: Thermodynamics of the $q$-deformed Kittel--Shore model for spin-1 particles
summary: Quantum algebras ($q$-algebras) have been used in the literature to deform spin-chain models. In particular, in previous works by the present authors, the Kittel--Shore Hamiltonian was deformed using $\mathfrak{su}_q(2)$ algebra. The deformed Hamiltonian was presented for a general spin, and the thermodynamic properties were studied for spin-1/2 particles. In this paper, we focus on the $q$-deformation of the Kittel--Shore model for spin-1 systems. We analyse the impact of this deformation on the thermodynamic properties and phase transitions of the system as a function of the deformation parameter $q$. Specifically, we study the specific heat, magnetic susceptibility, and magnetisation, including a detailed analysis of the Curie temperature characterising the ferromagnetic phase. Furthermore, a finite-size scaling analysis is conducted for both the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic cases. Results are systematically compared with those of the undeformed model to reveal the physical effects of the $q$-deformation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自旋-1的Kittel-Shore模型的$q$-形变（基于$\mathfrak{su}_q(2)$代数），分析形变参数$q$对系统热力学性质与相变的影响。
AI.motivation: 量子代数（$q$-代数）已被用于形变自旋链模型。作者此前用$\mathfrak{su}_q(2)$代数形变了Kittel-Shore哈密顿量，给出一般自旋形式并研究了自旋-1/2的热力学性质，本文将其推广到自旋-1系统。
AI.method: 对自旋-1的Kittel-Shore模型进行$q$-形变，研究比热、磁化率、磁化强度及铁磁相的居里温度，并对铁磁与反铁磁情形做有限尺寸标度分析。
AI.result: 给出了形变参数$q$对热力学性质与相变的影响，包括居里温度的详细分析；有限尺寸标度结果与未形变模型系统对比，揭示$q$-形变的物理效应。
AI.conclusion: $q$-形变显著改变自旋-1 Kittel-Shore模型的热力学行为与相变特征，通过对比未形变情形明确了形变的物理效应。

title: Quantum Representation Selects Neutral Skyrmion Molecules
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures + supplement; code and data available on Zenodo
summary: Skyrmions experience a sideways gyroscopic force when they move. Bound molecules can cancel this force; we call them gyroscopically neutral. We show that the quantum states available on each site of a magnet select the composition needed for cancellation. In two models of $SU(3)$ magnetism, this composition changes from a pair to a trimer. Both models assign exactly the same energy to every configuration of their common classical order parameter, isolating the effect of the local quantum states. Neutral molecules can also unwind when additional local states are allowed. Mean field calculations nevertheless find both compositions bound and locally stable, with the neutral trimer surviving sampled interaction changes. Comparing their motion reveals the changed cancellation rule, and prepared neutral molecules translate over short distances with little deformation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究磁性斯格明子（skyrmion）的"陀螺中性"束缚分子：当它们运动时受到侧向陀螺力，通过特定组分（pair或trimer）可抵消该力。作者证明局域量子态决定了所需组分，并通过平均场计算验证了这些中性分子的束缚性和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 斯格明子在运动时受侧向陀螺力影响，会使其偏离预期轨迹。若能构建束缚分子来抵消此力（即陀螺中性），则可实现更可控的输运。作者希望揭示局域量子态如何选择中性分子所需的组分。
AI.method: 采用两个SU(3)磁性模型，使它们在共同经典序参量下赋予每个构型完全相同的能量，从而隔离局域量子态效应。结合平均场计算分析束缚性、局域稳定性，并比较不同组分的运动方式。
AI.result: 在两种SU(3)模型中，中性组分从pair转变为trimer。允许额外局域态时中性分子可解耦。平均场计算显示两种组分都能束缚且局域稳定；中性trimer在采样相互作用变化下仍存在。比较运动揭示了不同的抵消规则，预制的neutral分子能短距离平移且形变很小。
AI.conclusion: 局域量子态决定了陀螺中性分子的最优组分，且中性分子（尤其是trimer）具有稳定性和良好的平移保形能力，为skyrmion输运控制提供了新途径。

title: Engineering Ferromagnetism in Wide Bandgap w-AlN for Spintronic Applications: Insights from DFT Calculations
comment: 16 pages, 14 figures, Revised and Expanded Version of the Previous Account
summary: Spintronics drives the search for functional materials, pursuing room-temperature dilute magnetic semiconductors to realize practical, energy-efficient devices. This paper presents a theoretical investigation into the magnetic properties of w-AlN doped with Cr, Ru, and Rh atoms, using spin-polarized density functional theory calculations with supercell models. Calculations of point-defect formation energies as a function of the Fermi level predict that Cr4+, Ru4+, and Rh3+ are the most favorable charge states substituting Al in w-AlN. With these preferred charge states, Cr-doped AlN is stable in the ferromagnetic state, preferable for spintronic devices, across a wide concentration range (1.85 to 16.67% of Al). Conversely, Ru- and Rh-doped AlN are unstable in the ferromagnetic state relative to the antiferromagnetic state. Further investigation into the electronic density of states reveals a fascinating evolution: for Cr concentrations below 5.56%, the Fermi level resides within the band gap directly above the valence band maximum, keeping the system insulating. It transitions to a high-spin half-metallic state between 7.40% and 12.96%, and finally transforms into a normal metal at 16.67% Cr. This behavior is absent in the DOS of the antiferromagnetic model of Ru- and Rh-doped systems, where insulating and metallic behaviors instead appear non-sequentially with varying concentrations.

AI.tldr: 本文用自旋极化DFT研究Cr、Ru、Rh掺杂w-AlN的磁性，发现Cr掺杂在宽浓度范围稳定铁磁，且在7.40%–12.96%区间呈半金属态，而Ru、Rh掺杂铁磁不稳定。
AI.motivation: 自旋电子学需要室温稀磁半导体以实现实用、节能器件，因此需要寻找合适的功能材料并理解其磁性行为。
AI.method: 采用自旋极化密度泛函理论（DFT）结合超胞模型，计算点缺陷形成能随费米能级的变化以确定最有利电荷态，并分析不同掺杂浓度下的电子态密度。
AI.result: Cr4+、Ru4+、Rh3+为替位Al的最有利电荷态；Cr掺杂AlN在1.85%–16.67%宽浓度范围内铁磁态稳定，而Ru、Rh掺杂相对反铁磁态铁磁不稳定。Cr低于5.56%时绝缘，7.40%–12.96%为高自旋半金属，16.67%变为普通金属；Ru、Rh反铁磁模型无此有序演化。
AI.conclusion: Cr掺杂w-AlN是自旋电子器件的潜在候选材料，其铁磁稳定性与浓度可调的半金属性尤为突出，而Ru、Rh掺杂因铁磁不稳定而不具优势。

title: Slow-fast dynamics of the McKean model with stochastic resetting and diffusion
summary: In this paper we investigate the combined effects of stochastic resetting and diffusion on a slow--fast dynamical system given by the piecewise-linear McKean model. That is, the fast variable $v$ is subject to Gaussian white noise with effective diffusivity $D$ and is reset to a fixed value $v_r$ at a random sequence of times generated from a Poisson process with rate $r$. Assuming that resetting occurs on the fast timescale, we freeze the slow variable \(w\) under an adiabatic approximation and determine the resulting non-equilibrium stationary state (NESS) of the fast variable as the solution of a modified Fokker--Planck equation. We show that the NESS can be expressed in terms of parabolic cylinder functions, whose asymptotic behavior allows us to recover the corresponding NESS without diffusion in the small-diffusion limit. The NESS is used to derive an averaged equation for the slow dynamics, whose solution converges to a stable fixed point \(w^*\) that depends on \(D\), \(r\) and \(v_r\). This fixed point effectively determines the long-time behaviour of the full system. Finally, we analyze the regime in which resetting occurs on the same timescale as the slow variable. We show how the slow variable now undergoes noisy oscillations due to resetting-induced switching between branches of the fast nullcline and derive the corresponding NESS for $w$ in the non-diffusive case.

AI.tldr: 研究随机重置与扩散对慢-快 McKean 系统的联合影响，推导快变量的非平衡稳态及其对慢动力学的平均效应。
AI.motivation: 探讨随机重置和扩散如何共同影响慢-快动力系统的长期行为，尤其是重置发生快/慢两种时标下的不同动力学。
AI.method: 对快变量施加高斯白噪声（扩散系数 D）并按泊松过程（速率 r）重置到 v_r；快时标下用绝热近似冻结慢变量，求解修正 Fokker-Planck 方程得非平衡稳态（用抛物柱函数表示）；慢时标下分析重置诱导的支路切换及噪声振荡。
AI.result: 快变量 NESS 可由抛物柱函数表示，小扩散极限可回复无扩散结果；慢动力学平均方程收敛到依赖 D、r、v_r 的稳定不动点 w*；重置与慢变量同尺度时，慢变量出现噪声振荡，并在无扩散情形下给出 w 的 NESS。
AI.conclusion: 随机重置与扩散共同控制慢-快系统的长期行为，可通过快变量 NESS 有效导出慢变量稳定不动点，并在同尺度重置下引发噪声振荡与支路切换。

title: When Is Molecular-Dynamics-Predicted Ionic Conductivity Reliable in Solid Electrolytes?
summary: Molecular dynamics is widely used to predict ionic conductivity in solid electrolytes, but the reliability of these predictions is often difficult to assess. Our analysis identifies finite trajectory length, limited cell size, and insufficient sampling as intrinsic limitations of finite atomistic ion-transport calculations. Cubic Li7La3Zr2O12 is used as a representative solid electrolyte to quantify their consequences. These limitations can remain hidden behind apparently linear mean-squared displacements and well-behaved Arrhenius relations, leading to inaccurate diffusivities, activation energies, and extrapolated ionic conductivities. Such inaccuracies can misrank candidate solid electrolytes and consequently misdirect computational screening and experimental validation. Here, we establish the local mean-squared-displacement exponent, α(t), as a quantitative reliability criterion that links dynamical convergence to errors in diffusivity and Nernst-Einstein ionic conductivity. The criterion further determines the minimum trajectory length required to achieve a prescribed accuracy as a function of temperature. Independent replicas reduce statistical uncertainty, while selective single-axis expansion mitigates finite-size effects. By establishing when simulated ionic conductivity is quantitatively trustworthy, this approach enables more reliable materials ranking and more efficient use of computational and experimental resources, thereby accelerating the development of high-performance solid electrolytes for solid-state batteries.

AI.tldr: 该文分析有限原子模拟中离子输运计算的内在局限，提出以局部MSD指数α(t)作为可靠性判据，量化并纠正扩散系数与离子电导率误差。
AI.motivation: 分子动力学广泛用于预测固态电解质离子电导率，但有限轨迹长度、有限晶胞尺寸和采样不足等局限常被看似线性的均方位移和良好Arrhenius关系掩盖，导致扩散系数、活化能和电导率不准确，进而错误排序候选电解质并误导计算筛选与实验验证。
AI.method: 以立方Li7La3Zr2O12为代表性固态电解质，识别并量化有限轨迹长度、有限晶胞尺寸和采样不足三大局限；引入局部均方位移指数α(t)作为连接动力学收敛与扩散系数、Nernst-Einstein电导率误差的定量可靠性判据，并据此确定达到指定精度所需的最小轨迹长度与温度关系；同时采用独立重复模拟降低统计不确定性，选择性单轴扩胞缓解有限尺寸效应。
AI.result: 该判据能揭示被线性MSD和良好Arrhenius关系掩盖的误差，量化扩散系数、活化能和电导率的外推偏差；可确定不同温度下满足预设精度所需的最小轨迹长度；独立重复与单轴扩胞分别有效降低统计不确定性和有限尺寸效应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作明确了模拟离子电导率何时定量可信，有助于更可靠的材料排序和更高效地使用计算与实验资源，从而加速固态电池高性能固态电解质的开发。

title: The memory equation of a characteristic function in surface diffusion: a sum rule
summary: The decay of a density wave in an interacting adlayer obeys an exact memory equation of Mori's form. Being a Fourier component of a conserved density, its correlation function is a characteristic function, and the kernel is built from a second one, that of a single jump. The local rate obeys a sum rule whose momentum dependence is one minus the characteristic function of a single jump, divided by the static structure factor. Detailed balance makes the decay a superposition of relaxation modes of non-negative weight whose moments are static equilibrium averages, so that the truncations of the associated continued fraction form a convergent hierarchy of closed forms, each of them a bound on the decay itself. The single rate a fit returns is shown to be the mean of the instantaneous rate over a time window, hence never above the local rate. At long wavelength, the two coincide, the relaxation spectrum separating there, one collective mode taking almost the whole weight of the density wave and the single exponential usually fitted to spin-echo data being the decay itself. What an experiment reaches at every wavevector is also the area under the decay, a correlation time. Together with the static structure factor and the single-jump geometry, it forms one combination which the theory identifies with the effective hop rate divided by the product of the local rate and the correlation time. That product never falls below unity and tends to unity at long wavelength whenever the rate at which an adparticle leaves a site is independent of the site it leaves for. In the hydrodynamic limit, the sum rule becomes a relation of Darken type in which the rate multiplied by the thermodynamic factor is the effective hop rate and not the mobility of a labelled adparticle.

AI.tldr: 本文用 Mori 记忆方程精确描述相互作用吸附层中密度波的衰减，其关联函数为特征函数，核由单跳跃特征函数构成，并给出局部速率求和规则、平衡态矩的正权弛豫模分解、连续分数截断的收敛有界层级。
AI.motivation: 理解相互作用吸附层中密度波衰减的微观机制，区分拟合的单指数速率与真实局部速率，并澄清长波长极限下扩散行为的正确表述。
AI.method: 采用 Mori 形式的精确记忆方程；利用守恒密度的傅里叶分量关联函数作为特征函数；引入单跳跃特征函数构造核；应用细致平衡与平衡态矩，构建连续分数截断层级。
AI.result: 拟合得到的单一速率是时间窗口内瞬时速率的均值，永不超过局部速率；长波长下二者重合，弛豫谱分离为单一集体模；实验可观测的关联时间与静态结构因子、单跳几何共同构成有效跳跃速率与局部速率、关联时间之积的关系；该乘积不低于1，且当离开率与起点无关时趋于1；流体力学极限下求和规则化为 Darken 型关系。
AI.conclusion: 该理论为吸附层密度波衰减提供了精确且收敛的描述框架，修正了通常将自旋回波单指数拟合速率等同于局部速率的理解，并给出 Darken 型关系中的有效跳跃速率而非标记粒子迁移率。

title: Modern triad for magnetic material science: geometric shape, electronic bands and spin textures
summary: To enable novel concepts in nanotechnologies, it is insightful to design materials with qualitatively new performances originating from recent discoveries in fundamental material science and physics. Curvilinear magnetism emerged as a tool to design chiral and anisotropic responses of materials at the nanoscale using the effects of the geometric shape and topology of the object. This concept is distinct yet complementary to material screening, which is primarily based on the optimization of intrinsic microscopic properties to modify magnetic textures for specific applications. Contemporary curvilinear magnetism focuses on mean-field micromagnetics, while the explicit contribution of the lattice structure and electronic degrees of freedom remains beyond consideration. In this review, we will emphasize on the effects which appear when this coupling is accounted for and that have resulted in novel concepts for the design of ``metageometric'' materials. Further development of this field will provide appealing technological prospects for fundamental understanding of curvilinear magnetic nanostructures and their applications in energy efficient and scalable nanoelectronics.

AI.tldr: 本文综述"曲线磁性"领域，强调几何形状与拓扑对纳米尺度磁性手性与各向异性响应的影响，并提出将晶格与电子自由度耦合纳入考量后所催生的"元几何"材料设计新概念。
AI.motivation: 为在纳米技术中实现新概念，需设计由材料科学与物理新发现驱动、具备全新性能的材料。传统材料筛选侧重优化微观本征属性，而曲线磁性提供了一条基于几何形状与拓扑的互补路径。但当前曲线磁性研究多局限于平均场微磁学，忽视了晶格结构与电子自由度的显式贡献。
AI.method: 这是一篇综述性文章，聚焦于当几何曲率与晶格结构、电子自由度发生耦合时所出现的效应，并借此提出"元几何"材料的设计概念，梳理该耦合所引发的相关新现象与理论框架。
AI.result: 论述了纳入上述耦合后涌现的新效应，并由此形成了"元几何"材料的全新设计概念，拓展了曲线磁性超出平均场微磁学的理论视野。
AI.conclusion: 该领域进一步发展将为曲线磁性纳米结构的基础理解及其在节能、可扩展纳米电子学中的应用带来诱人的技术前景。

title: Complexity drives the symmetry breaking of temperature fluctuations
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for publication in Physical Review E
summary: Frequently, nonextensive systems are described through $q$-exponential functions, where the $q$-parameter determines how far a system is from equilibrium. In this work, we study systems constrained to $q-1\ll1$ to describe systems near thermal equilibrium, and derive the probability density function and temperature fluctuations. To this end, we derive the series expansion of the $q$-exponential function, yielding a perturbative series that is a superposition of gamma distributions. On the other hand, the temperature fluctuations are expressed as a superposition of Dirac delta functions and their derivatives, meaning that the bulk of the system remains at a constant temperature, while point-temperature variations emerge, marking the system's departure from thermal equilibrium. The statistics of the temperature fluctuations exhibit a transition from a symmetric to a nonsymmetric distribution as the nonextensive parameter increases. These results provide evidence of the association between the emergence of nonextensivity and the symmetry breaking of temperature fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究近热平衡（$q-1\ll1$）的非广延系统，通过$q$-指数函数的级数展开推导出概率密度函数与温度涨落。
AI.motivation: 非广延系统常用$q$-指数函数描述，$q$参数表征系统偏离平衡的程度。作者希望刻画近热平衡系统（$q-1\ll1$），建立非广延性与温度涨落之间的联系。
AI.method: 对$q$-指数函数进行级数展开，得到可表示为Gamma分布叠加的微扰级数；同时将温度涨落表达为Dirac delta函数及其导数的叠加。
AI.result: 概率密度函数表现为Gamma分布的叠加；温度涨落由delta函数及其导数构成，表明系统主体保持恒定温度，而出现点状温度变化，标志系统偏离热平衡。随非广延参数增大，温度涨落统计由对称分布转变为非对称分布。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明非广延性的出现与温度涨落的对称性破缺之间存在关联。

title: Rare-earth Bilayer Triangular Lattice as a Platform for Tunable Ground States and Field-induced Magnetic Phases
summary: Rare-earth bilayer triangular lattice (TL) antiferromagnets provide a versatile platform for realizing diverse magnetic states by combining geometric frustration, interlayer coupling, and strong single-ion anisotropy. Here, we report a family of R2O2Se (R = Sm, Eu, Tb-Lu; ROSe) single crystals featuring bilayer equilateral TLs. Magnetic susceptibility and specific-heat measurements reveal predominantly antiferromagnetic (AFM) interactions and diverse magnetic ground states across the series, including successive AFM transitions in TbOSe and single AFM transitions in SmOSe, DyOSe, HoOSe, and YbOSe. Notably, DyOSe and HoOSe exhibit pronounced 1/2 magnetization plateau-like features for fields along the c-axis, revealing field-induced magnetic states. In HoOSe, complementary thermodynamic and magnetization measurements resolve three critical fields and a rich field-temperature phase diagram containing five distinct magnetic phases. These results establish rare-earth bilayer TLs as a chemically tunable materials platform for accessing novel quantum spin states through the interplay of lattice geometry, single-ion anisotropy, and competing magnetic interactions.

AI.tldr: 该研究报告了一类R2O2Se (ROSe)双层等边三角形晶格反铁磁单晶，通过磁化率和比热测量揭示了丰富的磁性基态，包括TbOSe的连续AFM转变及多种单次AFM转变，并在HoOSe中建立了含五个磁相和三个临界场的相图。
AI.motivation: 稀土双层三角晶格反铁磁体可结合几何阻挫、层间耦合和强单离子各向异性，是探索多样化磁性态的平台。作者希望利用这一平台寻找新颖量子自旋态，因此需要发现具有化学可调性的实际材料体系。
AI.method: 合成R2O2Se (R = Sm, Eu, Tb-Lu) 双层等边三角形晶格单晶；采用磁化率测量和比热测量表征磁性相互作用与基态；对DyOSe和HoOSe进行c轴方向磁场下磁化测量，并对HoOSe开展互补热力学与磁化测量以解析临界场和相图。
AI.result: 该系列材料以反铁磁相互作用为主，呈现多样磁基态：TbOSe有连续AFM转变；SmOSe、DyOSe、HoOSe、YbOSe为单次AFM转变。DyOSe和HoOSe在c轴磁场下表现出明显的1/2磁化平台特征，说明存在场诱导磁态。HoOSe中分辨出三个临界场，构建了包含五个不同磁相的丰富场-温度相图。
AI.conclusion: 稀土双层三角晶格（ROSe系列）可作为化学可调的材料平台，通过晶格几何、单离子各向异性和竞争磁相互作用的协同作用实现新颖量子自旋态。

title: A quantitative phase-field model for grain boundary trapping and diffusion of hydrogen
summary: Grain boundaries influence hydrogen transport in polycrystalline metals by acting as both trapping sites and interconnected diffusion pathways. Conventional interpretations of thermal desorption spectroscopy (TDS) and permeation experiments often treat traps as isolated defects, neglecting grain boundary connectivity and potentially misinterpreting experimental data. Here, we develop a quantitative phase-field model for hydrogen diffusion, grain boundary trapping, and grain boundary-assisted transport. The formulation preserves the physical grain boundary volume independently of the numerical interface thickness and accounts for anisotropic diffusion parallel and perpendicular to grain boundaries. Benchmark simulations verify quantitative behavior under interface upscaling. The model shows that grain boundary diffusion can significantly shift TDS peaks, making Kissinger-type analyses unreliable when grain boundary transport is significant. Effective diffusion coefficients are also shown to depend strongly on grain size, trapping free energy, temperature, and grain boundary mobility. These results highlight the coupled role of trapping thermodynamics, bulk diffusion, and grain-boundary transport.

AI.tldr: 本文建立定量相场模型，描述氢在多晶金属中的扩散、晶界捕获与晶界辅助输运，指出传统TDS分析在晶界连通性显著时可能失效。
AI.motivation: 传统对TDS和渗透实验的解读常将陷阱视为孤立缺陷，忽略了晶界连通性，可能导致实验数据被误读。晶界既作为捕获位点又作为相互连通的扩散通道，影响氢的输运。
AI.method: 发展为氢扩散、晶界捕获和晶界辅助输运的定量相场模型；保持晶界体积独立于数值界面厚度，并考虑平行与垂直于晶界的各向异性扩散；通过基准模拟验证界面尺度放大下的定量准确性。
AI.result: 晶界扩散可显著移动TDS峰，使Kissinger分析在晶界输运显著时不可靠；有效扩散系数强烈依赖晶粒尺寸、捕获自由能、温度和晶界迁移率。
AI.conclusion: 结果强调了捕获热力学、体扩散和晶界输运的耦合作用，修正了将陷阱视为孤立缺陷的传统观点。

title: Universal Drift Correction for Multidimensional Scanning Microscopy
summary: In scanning microscopy, drift causes the specimen to be sampled at positions displaced from the nominal probe positions. This displacement alters the spatial assignment of the recorded signals and biases quantitative measurements across two-dimensional imaging, channel-resolved spectroscopic mapping, and scan-position-resolved diffraction analysis. Here, we extend orthogonal-scan drift correction from 2D images to spectrum images and diffraction datasets. We demonstrate how to recover probe positions using either differently oriented multidimensional scans or structural reference images. The recovered positions are used either to resample the multidimensional data onto a regular grid or to assign each recorded signal to its corrected coordinate. Our method combines affine and non-rigid correction, requires no prior structural model, and is implemented as open-source, GPU-accelerated software that reduces processing times by two to three orders of magnitude, enabling routine and automated drift correction for quantitative multidimensional microscopy.

AI.tldr: 提出将正交扫描漂移校正从2D图像扩展到光谱图像和衍射数据集的方法，可恢复探针位置并重采样多维数据，无需先验结构模型，GPU加速使处理速度提升2-3个数量级。
AI.motivation: 扫描显微镜中的漂移使样品在偏离名义探针位置处被采样，导致记录信号的空间分配被改变，从而对二维成像、通道分辨光谱映射及扫描位置分辨衍射分析中的定量测量产生偏差。现有漂移校正多局限于2D图像，缺乏面向多维数据集的通用、自动化方案。
AI.method: 将正交扫描漂移校正从2D图像扩展至光谱图像和衍射数据集。通过不同取向的多维扫描或结构参考图像恢复探针位置，然后将多维数据重采样到规则网格，或将每个记录信号分配到校正后的坐标。方法结合仿射与非刚性校正，无需先验结构模型，并实现为开源GPU加速软件。
AI.result: 能够在二维成像、光谱成像和衍射数据中恢复探针位置并完成漂移校正；处理时间相比先前实现减少2至3个数量级，支持常规化和自动化漂移校正。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将正交扫描漂移校正推广至多维显微镜数据，兼顾精度与效率，为定量多维显微镜提供实用、自动化的漂移校正工具。

title: Thorium-229 as a Phonomagnetometer
summary: Thorium-229 possesses the only known low-energy nuclear transition suitable for spectroscopy with narrowband VUV lasers. While previous experiments have focused on application as a nuclear clock, this transition also offers a route to high-accuracy magnetometry. Experimental observations of magnetic fields generated by phonons carrying angular momentum remain inconclusive, highlighting the need for quantitative tests of the underlying physical mechanisms. In this article, we propose doping thorium-229 into a solid-state host to probe phonomagnetic fields in situ. We identify Na$_2$ThF$_6$, a chiral stoichiometric thorium compound, as a promising host material and evaluate its spectroscopic sensitivity to magnetic interactions under two excitation schemes: driving degenerate phonon modes with a circularly polarized laser, and applying a temperature gradient. Density functional theory simulations combined with quantitative estimates suggest that the temperature-gradient scheme yields a magnetic signal that appears too weak to be measurable, while a circularly polarized, high-intensity THz/VUV pump-probe driven phonomagnetic response may approach the shot-noise-limited detection threshold. While experimental challenges remain, the unique suitability of thorium-229 provides a testable pathway toward detecting phonomagnetic fields in a solid-state platform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将钍-229掺入固态基质（如Na₂ThF₆）以原位探测声子磁场，并评估两种激发方案的磁学灵敏度。
AI.motivation: 钍-229具有唯一已知适合窄带VUV激光光谱的低能核跃迁；除核钟应用外，该跃迁还可用于高精度磁力测量。然而，携带角动量的声子所产磁场尚无定论，亟需对物理机制的定量检验。
AI.method: 将钍-229掺入固态基质，选定手性化学计量比化合物Na₂ThF₆作为候选基质；评估两种激发方案下的磁相互作用光谱灵敏度：(1)圆偏振激光驱动简并声子模；(2)施加温度梯度。结合DFT模拟与定量估计。
AI.result: DFT与定量估计表明：温度梯度方案产生的磁信号过弱、难以测量；圆偏振高强度THz/VUV泵浦-探测驱动的声子磁响应可能接近散粒噪声极限探测阈值。
AI.conclusion: 尽管实验仍存挑战，钍-229的独特适用性为在固态平台中探测声子磁场提供了一条可检验的路径。

title: Infrared laser stimulated broadband white emission of transparent Cr:YAG ceramics obtained by solid state reaction sintering
summary: In the present work, the Light Induced White Emission (LIWE) was investigated as one of the sources of laser loss in transparent Cr:YAG ceramics. We have found that transparent Cr:YAG ceramics is capable of generating bright LIWE at excitation powers above a certain threshold. Intensity of LIWE strongly depends on the excitation power and ambient pressure. The host temperature estimated from Cr3+ luminescence was found to be below 600°C, while the most intense white emission was found between 50-400°C. The mechanism of the laser induced white emission was discussed in terms of Intervalence Charge Transfer (IVCT) in chromium mixed valence pair.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了透明Cr:YAG陶瓷中作为激光损耗来源的光致白光发射(LIWE)，发现其存在激发功率阈值，强度受激发功率和环境气压影响，并根据Cr³⁺荧光估算主体温度低于600°C。
AI.motivation: 透明Cr:YAG陶瓷可用作激光增益介质，但其光致白光发射(LIWE)构成激光损耗来源，因此需要研究该现象的机理与影响因素。
AI.method: 采用不同激发功率和环境气压条件下的光致发光测量，利用Cr³⁺荧光估算主体温度，并结合混合价态铬对间的价间电荷转移(IVCT)机制进行分析。
AI.result: Cr:YAG陶瓷在超过某阈值激发功率下可产生明亮的LIWE；LIWE强度强烈依赖激发功率和环境气压；由Cr³⁺荧光估算的主体温度低于600°C，最强白光发射出现在50–400°C之间。
AI.conclusion: LIWE是透明Cr:YAG陶瓷中的重要损耗机制，其行为可用铬混合价态对间的IVCT机制解释。

title: Binary magnetism and directional magnon transport in alkali-doped CrI$_3$
summary: The recent realization of two-dimensional (2D) magnets, with CrI$_3$ as a pioneering example, has opened new avenues in the fields of 2D materials and magnetism. This breakthrough has been followed by extensive efforts to manipulate and exploit their magnetic properties. In this work, we investigate the adsorption of alkali-metal atoms as a route to control the magnetic behavior of monolayer CrI$_3$. We show that, upon adsorption, alkali-metal atoms donate an electron to the CrI$_3$ layer, leading to the formation of inequivalent Cr sites, with one Cr atom exhibiting an enhanced magnetic moment of $4~μ_B$, while the other retains its typical $3~μ_B$ moment. These modifications significantly alter the magnetic exchange interactions, including the emergence of anisotropic exchange and Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interactions (DMI). Consequently, the doped systems exhibit non-collinear magnetic ground states, modified temperature-dependent magnetism, and anisotropic spin-wave propagation, with a preferred propagation direction that becomes increasingly pronounced with increasing dopant size. Furthermore, an asymmetry between spin-wave propagation in opposite directions is observed, giving rise to a diode-like effect, particularly for heavier dopants. This behavior is attributed to the enhanced DMI, which breaks the symmetry of the magnon dispersion. These results demonstrate that alkali-metal doping provides an effective route to tune anisotropic and nonreciprocal magnonic properties in two-dimensional magnetic materials.

AI.tldr: 通过碱金属原子吸附调控单层CrI₃的磁性质，诱导非共线磁基态、各向异性交换与DMI，实现各向异性及具有二极管效应的非互易自旋波传播。
AI.motivation: 二维磁体（如CrI₃）的发现开启新方向，亟需有效手段调控与利用其磁性；本文探索碱金属吸附作为控制单层CrI₃磁行为的途径。
AI.method: 研究碱金属原子在单层CrI₃上的吸附，分析电荷转移、Cr位点磁矩变化、磁交换相互作用（含各向异性交换与Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用DMI）及自旋波传播特性。
AI.result: 碱金属向CrI₃层转移电子，形成非等价Cr位点（一个Cr磁矩增至4 μ_B，另一个保持3 μ_B）；磁交换相互作用显著改变，出现各向异性交换与DMI；掺杂体系呈现非共线磁基态、温度磁性与自旋波传播各向异性，随掺杂原子尺寸增大择优传播方向更明显；反向自旋波传播不对称，产生类二极管效应，重掺杂时尤为显著，归因于DMI增强破坏磁振子色散对称性。
AI.conclusion: 碱金属掺杂为调控二维磁性材料中的各向异性与非互易磁振子性质提供了有效途径。

title: Experimental realization of the minimal two-dimensional multi-orbital kagome model
summary: Kagome materials have emerged as a major platform for correlated and topological quantum matter, hosting flat bands, Dirac dispersions and van Hove singularities rooted in frustrated lattice geometry. While their essential physics is epitomized by the canonical single-orbital kagome model, real kagome materials are intrinsically multi-orbital and typically chemically and structurally complex, with additional three-dimensional coupling making kagome geometry and orbital degrees of freedom difficult to disentangle. Here we realize a truly two-dimensional, elemental two-orbital kagome system in monolayer Sb on SiC(0001). Substrate-induced orbital filtering isolates the in-plane Sb p_x/p_y orbitals into a six-band kagome manifold, establishing a chemically simple, minimal platform for multi-orbital kagome physics. We demonstrate two consequences that distinguish this system from the canonical single-orbital model. First, chemically enforced half filling pins the Fermi level to a closed nodal line, whose finite density of states drives a unit-cell-conserving breathing instability and opens a giant insulating gap. Second, we uncover orbital-resolved atomic obstruction: individual orbital-derived manifolds realize obstructed atomic limits, whereas their combined half-filled valence manifold is non-obstructed. Our results establish kagome antimonene as a benchmark system for exploring orbital-driven electronic, structural and topological kagome physics in the genuine two-dimensional limit.

AI.tldr: 在SiC(0001)上生长的单层Sb实现了真正的二维双轨道kagome体系，揭示轨道筛选、呼吸不稳定性导致的巨大能隙以及轨道分辨的原子阻碍现象。
AI.motivation: 真实kagome材料多为多轨道且化学结构复杂，兼具三维耦合，难以分离kagome几何与轨道自由度。作者希望构建一个化学简单、真正二维的多轨道kagome最小平台来研究其本质物理。
AI.method: 在SiC(0001)衬底上生长单层Sb，利用衬底诱导的轨道筛选将面内Sb p_x/p_y轨道隔离成一个六能带kagome流形，并通过化学半填充和第一性原理计算分析其电子、结构及拓扑性质。
AI.result: 化学强制半填充将费米能级钉扎在闭合节线上，其有限态密度驱动保持晶胞的呼吸不稳定性并打开巨大绝缘能隙；同时发现轨道分辨的原子阻碍：单一轨道流形处于阻碍原子极限，而二者合成的半填充价带流形则是非阻碍的。
AI.conclusion: kagome锑烯成为在真正二维极限下探索轨道驱动的电子、结构与拓扑kagome物理的基准体系。

title: Unraveling the electronic structure and the oxygen $K$-edge x-ray absorption near-edge structure spectrum of DyFeO$_3$
summary: Rare-earth orthoferrites such as DyFeO$_3$ exhibit a rich interplay between localized rare-earth and transition-metal moments, giving rise to complex magnetic phases and magnetoelectric phenomena. Understanding their electronic and spectroscopic properties from first principles requires an accurate description of the localized Fe-$3d$ and Dy-$4f$ states and their hybridization with O-$2p$ states. Here, we combine first-principles calculations and x-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) measurements to investigate the electronic structure and the O $K$-edge spectrum of DyFeO$_3$. We employ density-functional theory (DFT) with Hubbard $U$ corrections (DFT+$U$) determined from first principles using density-functional perturbation theory, the HSE06 hybrid functional, and orbital-resolved DFT+$U$ with Hubbard parameters calibrated to reproduce the electronic structure computed using HSE06. We find that standard DFT+$U$, despite improving the band gap, substantially underestimates the crystal-field splitting of the unoccupied Fe-$3d$ states and consequently fails to accurately reproduce the separation of the two lowest-energy features in the O $K$-edge spectrum. HSE06 provides a more balanced description of the relevant electronic states, including the Fe-$3d$ crystal-field splitting. Mapping the corresponding electronic structure onto orbital-resolved DFT+$U$ yields a spectrum that remarkably reproduces the two lowest-energy experimental features and captures the main characteristics of the spectrum at higher energies. These results establish the low-energy O $K$-edge features as a sensitive probe of the Fe-$3d$ crystal-field splitting, while showing that the localized Dy-$4f$ states leave no distinct spectral fingerprints despite their importance for the magnetic properties.

AI.tldr: 本文结合第一性原理计算与XANES测量，研究DyFeO₃的电子结构和O K边谱，发现标准DFT+U低估Fe-3d晶场劈裂，而HSE06及轨道分辨DFT+U能更好地重现实验低能谱特征。
AI.motivation: 稀土正铁氧体（如DyFeO₃）中局域稀土与过渡金属磁矩相互作用复杂，产生丰富磁相和磁电现象。从第一性原理理解其电子与光谱性质，需准确描述局域Fe-3d、Dy-4f态及其与O-2p的杂化。
AI.method: 采用DFT+U（U由密度泛函微扰理论第一性原理确定）、HSE06杂化泛函，以及以HSE06电子结构校准的轨道分辨DFT+U；并与O K边XANES测量对比。
AI.result: 标准DFT+U虽改善带隙，但显著低估未占据Fe-3d的晶场劈裂，无法准确重现O K边最低两个特征的分裂。HSE06对相关电子态（含Fe-3d晶场劈裂）描述更均衡；将其电子结构映射到轨道分辨DFT+U可很好地重现低能两个实验特征，并捕捉高能区主要特征。
AI.conclusion: 低能O K边特征可作为Fe-3d晶场劈裂的灵敏探针；局域Dy-4f态虽对磁性质重要，但不产生明显的光谱指纹。

title: Current-voltage characteristics and resistive switching in epitaxial La$_{0.67}$Sr$_{0.33}$MnO$_3$/SrMnO$_3$/La$_{0.67}$Sr$_{0.33}$MnO$_3$ multilayer
summary: In present study, we investigate the structural properties and current-voltage ($I$-$V$) characteristics of an epitaxial multilayer composed of La$_{0.67}$Sr$_{0.33}$MnO$_3$ (25 nm)/SrMnO$_3$ (70 nm)/La$_{0.67}$Sr$_{0.33}$MnO$_3$ (25 nm), grown on different substrates i.e., SrTiO$_3$(100), LaAlO$_3$(100), Si (100). The used substrates not only have different chemical compositions in line with the film materials, also they have different lattice parameters which would tune the material chemistry and lattice strain at the interface significantly. Our $I$-$V$ measurements reveal distinct electrical behaviors depending on the substrate. The multilayers grown on oxide SrTiO$_3$(100) and LaAlO$_3$(100) substrates exhibit regular $I$-$V$ with slight nonlinearity at low applied voltages. In contrast, $I$-$V$ in multilayer with Si(100) substrate exhibits large asymmetry and notable resistive switching (RS) behavior at room temperature, where a resistance ratio around 10 between the high resistance state (HRS) and low resistance state (LRS) is observed. While the observed $I$-$V$ behavior is sensitive to substrate-induced interfacial disorder and formation of trap bands within bandgap of SrMnO$_3$, the present results have potential applications in future memory and memristive devices.

AI.tldr: 研究LSMO/SrMnO3/LSMO外延多层膜在不同衬底上的结构与I-V特性，Si衬底上出现显著阻变行为，阻变比约10，具存储与忆阻器应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 衬底化学组成与晶格参数不同会调控界面材料化学与晶格应变，从而影响多层膜的电流-电压行为，因此需探究衬底对LSMO/SrMnO3/LSMO多层膜电学特性的影响。
AI.method: 在SrTiO3(100)、LaAlO3(100)和Si(100)衬底上生长La0.67Sr0.33MnO3(25 nm)/SrMnO3(70 nm)/La0.67Sr0.33MnO3(25 nm)外延多层膜，并测量其结构性质与I-V特性。
AI.result: 氧化物衬底(SrTiO3、LaAlO3)上的多层膜I-V较规则，低电压下略有非线性；Si(100)衬底上的多层膜I-V呈大不对称性，并在室温下表现出明显阻变，HRS/LRS阻变比约10。
AI.conclusion: I-V行为受衬底诱导的界面无序及SrMnO3带隙内陷阱带形成影响，该结果在未来存储器和忆阻器件中具潜在应用。

title: Electron paramagnetic resonance of Dy${^3+}$-doped CaWO$_4$: spin Hamiltonian, crystal-field analysis, and linear electric field effect
summary: We report an electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) study of Dy${^3+}$ in CaWO$_4$ single crystals spanning dopant concentrations from 80~ppb to 247~ppm. The $g$ factors of the ground Kramers doublet at the $S_4$ point-group site, $g_\parallel = 7.22 \pm 0.01$ and $g_\perp = 5.45 \pm 0.01$, and the hyperfine constants of \ce{^{161}Dy} and $^{163}$Dy are determined with an order-of-magnitude improvement in precision over the only previous report. A crystal-field analysis constrained jointly by published optical levels and by the measured $g$ tensor identifies the ground doublet as the lower branch of an anticrossing between the near-degenerate $\|{\pm}11/2>$ and $\|{\mp}13/2>$ states, and explains why optical data alone left the $g$ values unconstrained. \add{The same parameter set, tested on the excited multiplets of the $^6H$ term, reproduces the ${}^6H_{13/2}$ crystal-field levels better than the optical parameters themselves.} The angular dependence of the linewidth in the $ab$ plane reveals broadening by random internal electric fields through the linear electric field effect. Calibrating these fields with the residual Er$^{3+}$ present in the same crystals yields the first electric-field coupling parameters of Dy$^3+$, $(B_{31}^2+B_{36}^2)^{1/2} = (34\pm5)\times10^{-6}$~cm/V, three times the Er$^{3+}$ value and the largest reported for a rare-earth ion in this host.The residual linewidth and the concentration-dependent lineshape asymmetry follow the quadratic field scaling expected for a second-order Stark shift, which escapes the inversion-site cancellation constraining the linear effect. Both couplings trace back to the $\sim 20$~cm$^{-1}$ gap to the first opposite-symmetry doublet, a consequence of the dense crystal-field structure of the $J=15/2$ manifold.

AI.tldr: 本文通过EPR研究CaWO₄中Dy³⁺，精确测定g因子与超精细常数，识别基态双重态，并首次给出Dy³⁺的电场耦合参数。
AI.motivation: 此前仅有单一报道给出Dy³⁺的g因子且精度有限，光学数据无法约束g值，基态波函数构成不明，且Dy³⁺的电场耦合参数从未测得。
AI.method: 对掺杂80 ppb至247 ppm的CaWO₄:Dy³⁺单晶进行EPR测量；结合已发表光学能级做晶体场分析；通过ab面线宽角度依赖研究线性电场效应，并用残余Er³⁺标定电场。
AI.result: g因子为g∥=7.22±0.01、g⊥=5.45±0.01，超精细常数精度提升一个数量级；基态为|±11/2⟩与|∓13/2⟩反交叉下支；首次测得(B₃₁²+B₃₆²)^½=(34±5)×10⁻⁶ cm/V，为Er³⁺的三倍；残余线宽与浓度依赖线型不对称符合二阶Stark移的二次场标度。
AI.conclusion: Dy³⁺的线性与二阶电场耦合均源于至第一反称双重态约20 cm⁻¹的能隙，这是J=15/2流形密集晶体场结构的结果。

title: First-principles calculations of the thermodynamic factor of multicomponent alloys
summary: Computing non-dilute diffusion coefficients from Onsager transport coefficients of a multicomponent alloy requires the thermodynamic factor, which measures the curvature of the free energy with respect to composition. As diffusion in metals is mediated by vacancies, the curvature that matters is not that of the vacancy-free alloy, which is straightforward to compute, but that of an alloy carrying a dilute concentration of vacancies. The resulting matrix is nearly singular, and composition fluctuations from which it is obtained converge slowly in Monte Carlo simulations. Here we develop two routes that avoid sampling vacancy composition fluctuations. The first constructs the thermodynamic factor from two quantities, the free-energy curvature of the vacancy-free alloy and the vacancy concentration. The second truncates the semi-grand canonical partition function at a single vacancy and recovers the full thermodynamic factor of the vacancy-containing alloy. The same separation shows that the largest eigenvalue of the diffusion matrix is the vacancy tracer diffusion coefficient for any number of components and any degree of non-ideality, while the remaining eigenvalues scale with the vacancy concentration. Across binary through quinary alloys of the Hf--Mo--Nb--Ti--Zr system, both routes reproduce eigenvalues and eigenvectors of diffusion matrices obtained from fully converged Monte Carlo simulations. The single-vacancy expansion reaches this accuracy with roughly one tenth of the sampling effort. A scaling relation extends both routes to local vacancy chemical potentials away from equilibrium, without additional simulations. These results allow thermodynamic descriptions from atomistic models or CALPHAD assessments to be used directly in mesoscale simulations of mass transport.

AI.tldr: 该文提出两条避免采样空位浓度涨落的路径来计算含空位多元合金的Onsager热力学因子，从而高效获得非稀溶液扩散系数。
AI.motivation: 金属中扩散由空位介导，所需的是含稀浓度空位合金的自由能曲率，而非无空位合金的曲率。但含空位体系的自由能曲率矩阵接近奇异，其组成涨落在蒙特卡洛模拟中收敛缓慢，采样成本高。
AI.method: 提出两条途径：(1) 由无空位合金的自由能曲率与空位浓度两个量构造热力学因子；(2) 将半巨正则配分函数截断至单个空位，恢复含空位合金的完整热力学因子。同时分离出扩散矩阵的特征值结构，并给出将结果推广至非平衡局域空位化学势的标度关系。
AI.result: 在Hf–Mo–Nb–Ti–Zr体系的二元至五元合金中，两条途径均重现了完全收敛蒙特卡洛模拟得到的扩散矩阵特征值与特征向量；单空位展开仅需约十分之一的采样量即可达到该精度。扩散矩阵最大特征值等于空位示踪扩散系数（对任意组分数与非理想度成立），其余特征值随空位浓度标度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可让来自原子尺度模型或CALPHAD评估的热力学描述直接用于介观尺度质量输运模拟。

title: High-throughput computational discovery of CuI-based ternary $p$-type transparent conductors
summary: P-type transparent conducting materials (TCMs) remain scarce, limiting progress in transparent electronics and tandem photovoltaics. Here, we perform a high-throughput computational search across CuI-based ternary X--Cu--I compounds using the minima hopping method combined with density functional theory. Filtering for thermodynamic stability, optical transparency, and light hole effective mass, we identify 58 candidate p-type TCMs, of which 49 are previously unreported. Twenty are p-type degenerate semiconductors with intrinsic hole carriers, including Cu$_2$FI$_2$ (calculated gap 3.75 eV, hole effective mass $0.262\,m_0$). We further use this dataset to revisit the chemical modulation of the valence band (CMVB) design rules, originally formulated for Cu-based delafossite oxides. Four generalizations emerge: linear Cu coordination is not required, as tetrahedral coordination (CN = 4) is compatible with p-type TCM character; the mechanism extends to halide-based systems with I $5p$ anion states; the Cu $d$ state energy center $ε_d$ is a quantitative descriptor for valence band dispersion; and Cu undercoordination in monovalent-anion hosts drives intrinsic p-type carrier generation through stoichiometric charge balance. These results establish a generalized computational framework for the design of p-type halide TCMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高通量计算筛选CuI基三元X-Cu-I化合物，鉴定出58种候选p型透明导电材料（49种此前未报道），并据此将化学调制价带（CMVB）设计规则从铜基铜铁矿氧化物推广至卤化物体系。
AI.motivation: p型透明导电材料（TCMs）长期稀缺，制约了透明电子学与叠层光伏的发展，亟需拓展p型TCM的材料空间并建立通用设计准则。
AI.method: 采用minima hopping方法结合密度泛函理论对CuI基三元X-Cu-I化合物进行高通量计算搜索，并以热力学稳定性、光学透明性和轻空穴有效质量为筛选条件。
AI.result: 筛选出58种候选p型TCMs（49种为新报道），其中20种为本征空穴载流子的p型简并半导体，如Cu2FI2（计算带隙3.75 eV，空穴有效质量0.262 m0）。基于该数据集提炼出CMVB规则的四条推广结论。
AI.conclusion: CMVB设计规则得到四点推广：线性Cu配位非必需（四面体CN=4同样可行）；机制可扩展至含I 5p阴离子态的卤化物体系；Cu d态能心ε_d可作为价带色散的定量描述符；单价阴离子宿主中Cu欠配位通过化学计量电荷平衡驱动本征p型载流子生成。由此建立了p型卤化物TCM设计的通用计算框架。

title: Polar discontinuity screening by charge disproportionation in ferroelectric-nickelate superlattices
summary: We use density functional theory (DFT) to demonstrate rearrangement of charge disproportionation as a new mechanism for screening polar discontinuities at heterointerfaces. We focus on SmNiO$_3$, a III-III perovskite characterized by an insulating ground state that originates from disproportionation of the electrons at the Ni sites. When interfaced with ferroelectric, II-IV perovskite BaTiO$_3$, this system can display a polar discontinuity whose magnitude is determined by the nature of the interface (NiO$_2$-BaO or SmO-TiO$_2$) and the orientation of the BaTiO$_3$ spontaneous polarization. In the orientation maximizing the interface charge, SmNiO$_3$ compensates by transferring 1 $e$/f.u. between the two interfaces and modifying the disproportionation sequence from Ni$^{4+}$/Ni$^{2+}$ to Ni$^{2+}$/Ni$^{2+}$ at the SmO-TiO$_2$ interface and to Ni$^{4+}$/Ni$^{4+}$ at the NiO$_2$-BaO interface. While this mechanism is potentially universal in all perovskites exhibiting charge disproportionation, our formal analysis of BiNiO$_3$/BaTiO$_3$ superlattices suggests that larger polar discontinuities may need more complex disproportionation patterns for screening.

AI.tldr: 提出电荷歧化重排可作为筛选异质界面极性不连续性的新机制。
AI.motivation: 探索在极性异质界面处，除传统电子重构外的新型屏蔽机制。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论(DFT)研究 SmNiO3/BaTiO3 界面 (NiO2-BaO 或 SmO-TiO2)，并形式化分析 BiNiO3/BaTiO3 超晶格。
AI.result: 在最大界面电荷取向下，SmNiO3 通过在两个界面间转移 1 e/f.u. 并使歧化序列从 Ni4+/Ni2+ 变为 SmO-TiO2 处的 Ni2+/Ni2+ 和 NiO2-BaO 处的 Ni4+/Ni4+ 来补偿。
AI.conclusion: 该机制在所有具电荷歧化的钙钛矿中可能普遍，但更大极性不连续性可能需要更复杂的歧化模式。

title: Dielectric response of the antiferromagnetic multiferroics with cycloidal equilibrium for the polarization related to the noncollinear spins
summary: Linear dynamics of the small amplitude perturbations in the antiferromagnetic multiferroics is analytically considered. Equilibrium state in the considered regime is assumed to be cycloidal structure both for the antiferromagnetic vector and the nonzero magnetization vector (presence of weak ferromagnetism in the system is included). The electric polarization of spin origin related to the "noncollinear" spins is considered and its influence on the spin dynamics is included. The dynamical electric susceptibility tensor is obtained to demonstrate response of the multiferroics on the alternating electric field. Existence of two polarization projections is found, response of each of them on two projections of the electric field perpendicular to the cycloid direction is presented. Different roles of the in plane and out of plane electric perturbations is demonstrated analytically. Essential role of the low frequency gapless spin wave in the dielectric response is described. Contributions of the spiral structure and the weak ferromagnetism in the dielectric response are specified.

AI.tldr: 本文解析研究了反铁磁多铁材料中小振幅扰动的线性动力学，考虑cycloidal结构与弱铁磁性，推导动态电极化率张量，揭示低频无隙自旋波在介电响应中的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 研究反铁磁多铁中自旋起源电极化与自旋动力学的耦合，理解多铁材料对交变电场的响应机制。
AI.method: 对反铁磁多铁小振幅扰动做线性动力学解析分析。假设反铁磁矢量与磁化矢量均呈cycloidal结构（含弱铁磁性），纳入非共线自旋产生的电极化及其对自旋动力学的影响，并求解动态电极化率张量。
AI.result: 得到动态电极化率张量，发现两个极化投影，分别对应垂直于cycloid方向的两个电场分量的响应；面内与面外电扰动作用不同；低频无隙自旋波对介电响应有本质贡献，并区分了螺旋结构与弱铁磁性的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 反铁磁多铁中自旋动力学与电极化强烈耦合，低频无隙自旋波主导介电响应，螺旋结构与弱铁磁性各自贡献明确，为多铁材料电控自旋提供理论依据。

title: Crystallographic-orientation dependence of the early-stage oxidation of Zr single crystals: an XPS study of suboxide formation and in-depth distribution
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, Submitted to Journal of Nuclear Materials
summary: The influence of crystallographic orientation on the early stages of the oxidation of pure Zr single crystals was studied by X ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). Two samples, cut from the same a-Zr single crystal, were oxidized simultaneously at room temperature and O2 pressures of 1 X 10-8, 1 X 10-7 and 1 X 10-6 torr: one with its surface normal parallel to the c-axis (Z1, basal (0001) plane) and the other with its normal 12deg from that of a prismatic plane (Z2, near-prismatic orientation). At all three pressures the oxidation kinetics of both samples followed a three stage, logarithmic type behaviour, but the near prismatic sample (Z2) incorporated oxygen faster and to a greater extent than the basal sample (Z1) in every case. Deconvolution of the Zr 3d core level spectra resolved, in addition to metallic Zr and ZrO2, two sub-stoichiometric Zr O compounds, denoted (ZrO)a and (ZrO)b, with binding-energy shifts of 1.3 and 2.3 eV with respect to metallic Zr, consistent with sub oxides previously reported for polycrystalline Zr. Angle resolved XPS showed that ZrO2 is the outermost compound in both orientations, while the two sub-oxides are distributed nearly homogeneously through the film. Oxide thicknesses, calculated from the attenuation of the metallic Zr 3d signal, ranged from 10 to 13 A for Z1 and from 14 to 19 A for Z2 depending on the oxidation pressure, in close agreement with earlier measurements on cold worked polycrystalline Zr, whose surface texture is dominated by prismatic-oriented grains.

AI.tldr: 用XPS研究纯Zr单晶氧化初期行为，发现近棱柱面(Z2)比基面(Z1)吸氧更快更多，氧化遵从三阶段对数规律，氧化层由ZrO2外层与两个亚氧化态组成。
AI.motivation: 多晶Zr表面织构以棱柱取向晶粒为主，其氧化行为可能受晶体取向影响，但以往研究多基于多晶样品，缺乏对单晶不同取向的对比，故需明确晶体取向对Zr初期氧化的作用。
AI.method: 取同一α-Zr单晶切出两个样品：Z1表面法线平行c轴（基面0001），Z2表面法线偏离棱柱面12°（近棱柱取向）。在室温、O2分压1×10⁻⁸、1×10⁻⁷、1×10⁻⁶ torr下同时氧化，用XPS测量，并做Zr 3d芯能级谱解卷积及角分辨XPS分析。
AI.result: 三种压力下两样品氧化动力学均呈三阶段对数型，但Z2吸氧更快更多。Zr 3d谱除金属Zr和ZrO2外，还解析出两个亚化学计量Zr-O化合物(ZrO)a、(ZrO)b，相对金属Zr的能移分别1.3和2.3 eV。角分辨XPS显示ZrO2在两取向中均为最外层，两个亚氧化物在膜内近似均匀分布。由金属Zr信号衰减算得氧化层厚度：Z1为10–13 Å，Z2为14–19 Å（随压力变化），与早期冷加工多晶Zr（表面织构以棱柱取向晶粒为主）的测量结果吻合。
AI.conclusion: 晶体取向显著影响纯Zr初期氧化：近棱柱取向比基面更易且更充分地吸氧，生成更厚的氧化膜；这解释了棱柱织构主导的多晶Zr的氧化行为，并证实ZrO2为外层、亚氧化物均匀分布于膜内。

title: Retrainable physics-integrated neural differentiable modeling of sintering across material systems
summary: Sintering is widely used to manufacture ceramics, but coupled densification and grain growth, material-dependent kinetics, and sparse measurements complicate predictive modeling and process design. We present Sinter-PiNDiff, a retrainable physics-integrated neural differentiable framework for predicting density and grain-size evolution. Two neural networks learn densification and grain-growth coefficients within coupled rate equations, while a smooth saturation factor attenuates densification near theoretical density. The same governing structure, network architecture, and training procedure were fitted independently to published data for MgO, Al-doped ZnO, and CaO-doped ThO2. Tests at held-out temperatures and compositions yielded the lowest mean error in all twelve material-metric comparisons against multilayer perceptron and residual network baselines. For MgO, Al-doped ZnO, and CaO-doped ThO2, respectively, density normalized root-mean-square errors were 14.6%, 10.8%, and 14.4%, and grain-size errors using the same metric were 8.6%, 12.1%, and 19.3%. Removing evolving density from both neural-network inputs increased density and grain-size trajectory errors in all three systems and ten of twelve aggregate errors, supporting density-dependent kinetic feedback. Deep ensembles estimated model disagreement, but empirical coverage showed that the uncertainty bands were not calibrated and did not capture all model-data discrepancies. These results establish Sinter-PiNDiff as a retrainable framework for sparse-data prediction and uncertainty-informed selection of sintering conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出Sinter-PiNDiff——可重训练的物理集成神经可微框架，用双网络学习致密化与晶粒生长系数，成功预测MgO、Al掺杂ZnO、CaO掺杂ThO2的烧结演化。
AI.motivation: 烧结过程致密化与晶粒生长耦合、动力学依赖材料、数据稀疏，导致预测建模与工艺设计困难。
AI.method: 将两个神经网络嵌入耦合速率方程学习致密化和晶粒生长系数，并用平滑饱和因子在接近理论密度时衰减致密化；同一结构与训练流程独立拟合三种材料数据。
AI.result: 在12项材料-指标对比中误差均低于MLP和ResNet基线；MgO、Al-ZnO、CaO-ThO2密度NRMSE分别为14.6%、10.8%、14.4%，晶粒尺寸误差为8.6%、12.1%、19.3%；移除演化密度输入会增大误差，支持密度依赖反馈；深度集成给出不确定性但覆盖未校准。
AI.conclusion: Sinter-PiNDiff是可重训练框架，适用于稀疏数据预测及基于不确定性的烧结条件选择。

title: Structural prediction of B$_{18}$Y$_{2}$ cluster: A Machine-Learning-Assisted Basin-Hopping Study
summary: The structural and optical properties of the doubly yttrium-doped boron cluster B$_{18}$Y$_2$ have been systematically investigated using density functional theory calculations. The lowest-energy structure was identified through extensive basin-hopping searches accelerated by a pre-trained MACE machine-learning potential and subsequently refined and validated at the DFT level. The resulting global-minimum structure adopts a double-ring geometry, consisting of two fused B$_9$ rings stabilized by yttrium atoms positioned above and below the boron framework. Vibrational frequency calculations confirm the dynamical stability of the optimized structure, while the calculated infrared and UV--Vis spectra provide characteristic signatures of the Y--B interactions and the electronic structure of the boron framework. These results demonstrate how yttrium doping can stabilize unusual double-ring boron architectures and highlight the effectiveness of machine-learning-assisted basin-hopping searches for exploring the complex potential-energy landscapes of doped boron clusters.

AI.tldr: 本文用DFT结合MACE机器学习势加速的basin-hopping搜索，确定了双钇掺杂硼团簇B18Y2的全局最低能量结构为双环构型，并分析了其振动稳定性与红外、紫外-可见光谱特征。
AI.motivation: 掺杂硼团簇的势能面复杂，传统搜索方法难以高效找到全局最低能量结构，需借助机器学习势加速搜索，并探究钇掺杂对硼骨架结构的稳定作用。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算；以预训练的MACE机器学习势加速的basin-hopping全局搜索寻找最低能量结构，再在DFT层面优化与验证；进行振动频率计算及红外、紫外-可见光谱计算。
AI.result: 全局最低能量结构为双环几何构型，由两个融合的B9环组成，钇原子位于硼骨架上下两侧稳定该结构；振动频率计算证实其动力学稳定性；红外与紫外-可见光谱给出了Y-B相互作用和硼骨架电子结构的特征信号。
AI.conclusion: 钇掺杂能够稳定非常规的双环硼结构，同时表明机器学习辅助的basin-hopping搜索在探索掺杂硼团簇复杂势能面方面十分有效。

title: Unconventional magnetoelastic behavior in Al rich CoFeAl Films with inverse Heusler like local order for flexible spintronics
summary: Strain engineering of magnetic properties offers a promising route toward flexible spintronic applications. Here, we report an unconventional magnetoelastic response in Al rich Co Fe Al thin films on flexible substrates using strain dependent magneto optical Kerr effect microscopy and magnetometry measurements. While the films exhibit a conventional positive magnetostriction coefficient, consistent with standard in plane easy axis rotation under stress, their saturation magnetization increases under compressive strain and decreases under tensile strain. First principles calculations reveal that this unconventional response originates from a strain induced competition between exchange splitting and crystal field effects in an inverse Heusler like local environment created by Al enrichment. This leads to a highly sensitive, sublattice dependent magnetic state, consistent with a strain induced reconfiguration of Co and Fe moments. Our results demonstrate that local compositional tuning can fundamentally alter magnetoelastic behavior, establishing strain controlled sublattice compensation as a route toward programmable magnetic functionality in flexible spintronic systems.

AI.tldr: 富Al的Co-Fe-Al柔性薄膜表现出反常磁弹响应：压缩应变下饱和磁化强度升高，拉伸应变下降低，源于应变诱导的交换劈裂与晶场效应竞争及Co/Fe亚晶格重构。
AI.motivation: 探索柔性自旋电子学应用中通过应变工程调控磁性的新途径，并理解局部成分调控如何改变磁弹行为。
AI.method: 在柔性衬底上生长富Al的Co-Fe-Al薄膜，结合应变依赖的磁光克尔效应显微术与磁测量，并辅以第一性原理计算。
AI.result: 薄膜呈现常规正磁致伸缩系数（面内易轴随应力旋转），但饱和磁化强度在压缩应变下升高、拉伸应变下降低。第一性原理表明该反常响应源于富Al形成的类反Heusler局域环境中应变诱导的交换劈裂与晶场效应竞争，导致高度敏感、亚晶格依赖的磁态与Co、Fe磁矩重构。
AI.conclusion: 局部成分调控可从根本上改变磁弹行为，应变控制的亚晶格补偿为实现柔性自旋电子系统的可编程磁功能提供了途径。
